mapper.update: update ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission ooc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON ooc.order_id = oob.order_id set ooc.order_status = 3, ooc.fx_settlement_status = 1, ooc.fx_settlement_time = NOW(), ooc.settle_record_id = #{settleRecordId} where ooc.order_id = #{orderId} and ooc.fx_settlement_status = 0 and ooc.commission_type = 1 AND oob.order_last_return_time <= NOW() AND oob.order_refund_status != 1 AND oob.order_return_status != 1 and oob.order_status in (5, 6, 9)
mapper.select: SELECT ooc.order_commission_id, ooc.order_id, ooc.buy_user_id, ooc.share_user_id, ooc.share_user_name, ooc.share_user_mobile, ooc.tg_one_user_id, ooc.tg_one_user_name, ooc.tg_one_user_mobile, ooc.tg_two_user_id, ooc.tg_two_user_name, ooc.tg_two_user_mobile, ooc.commission_type FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission ooc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON ooc.order_id = oob.order_id WHERE ooc.fx_settlement_status = 0 and ooc.commission_type = 1 AND oob.order_last_return_time <= NOW() AND oob.order_refund_status != 1 AND oob.order_return_status != 1 and oob.order_status in ( 5, 6, 9) GROUP BY ooc.order_id

SELECT sum(fx_commission - return_fx_commission) as fxCommissionMoney, sum(one_tg_commission - return_one_tg_commission) as oneTgCommissionMoney, sum(two_tg_commission - return_two_tg_commission) as twoTgCommissionMoney FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission ooc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON ooc.order_id = oob.order_id WHERE ooc.fx_settlement_status = 0 and ooc.commission_type = 1 AND oob.order_last_return_time <= NOW() AND oob.order_refund_status != 1 AND oob.order_return_status != 1 and oob.order_status in (5, 6, 9) and ooc.order_id = #{orderId}
